name: 旋转冲刺
description: 仅向上下左右四个正方向冲刺至多5格，终点须为未被占据的空地或掩体；可穿过单位和障碍，对路径敌人造成150%攻击力物理伤害。动能3：冲刺距离+2；动能5：命中敌人沉默1回合。
code: function executeSkill(context) { var c=context.piece, b=context.battle; var pos=selectTarget({type:'grid',range:5,filter:'all'}); if(!pos||pos.needsTargetSelection)return pos; var dx=Math.sign(pos.x-c.x),dy=Math.sign(pos.y-c.y); if((dx===0&&dy===0)||(dx!==0&&dy!==0))return {success:false,message:'请选择5格内上下左右方向'}; var steps=Math.max(Math.abs(pos.x-c.x),Math.abs(pos.y-c.y)); if(steps<1||steps>5)return {success:false,message:'冲刺距离须为1至5格'}; var destination=b.map.tiles.find(function(t){return t.x===pos.x&&t.y===pos.y;}); if(!destination||!destination.props.walkable||(destination.props.type!=='floor'&&destination.props.type!=='cover')||b.pieces.some(function(p){return p.currentHp>0&&p.x===pos.x&&p.y===pos.y&&p.instanceId!==c.instanceId;}))return {success:false,message:'冲刺终点必须是未被占据的空地或掩体'}; var momentum=c.momentum||0; if(momentum>=3)steps+=2; var last=null,hits=[]; for(var i=1;i<=steps;i++){var x=c.x+dx*i,y=c.y+dy*i,tile=b.map.tiles.find(function(t){return t.x===x&&t.y===y;}); if(!tile)break; var occupied=b.pieces.some(function(p){return p.currentHp>0&&p.x===x&&p.y===y&&p.instanceId!==c.instanceId;}); if(!occupied&&tile.props.walkable&&(tile.props.type==='floor'||tile.props.type==='cover'))last={x:x,y:y}; b.pieces.filter(function(p){return p.currentHp>0&&p.ownerPlayerId!==c.ownerPlayerId&&p.x===x&&p.y===y;}).forEach(function(p){var r=dealDamage(c,p,Math.floor(c.attack*1.5),'physical',b,context.skill.id); if(momentum>=5&&!p.statusTags.some(function(t){return t.type==='silenced';})){p.statusTags.push({id:'sonic-silence-'+p.instanceId,type:'silenced',name:'沉默',stacks:1,currentDuration:1,relatedRules:['rule-silenced-block']});addRuleById(p.instanceId,'rule-silenced-block');} hits.push(p.name+'(-'+r.damage+')');}); } if(!last)return {success:false,message:'没有可落脚的空地或掩体'}; var distance=Math.max(Math.abs(last.x-c.x),Math.abs(last.y-c.y)); c.x=last.x;c.y=last.y;c.momentum=(c.momentum||0)+distance; return {success:true,message:'冲刺至('+last.x+','+last.y+')'+(hits.length?'，命中'+hits.join('、'):'')}; }
